scientific_question: Does output-group-localizing the compact feedback levels remove the global carry codec distortion while preserving the already-passed c_fc/c_proj weight-chart conservation?

causal_basis.observation: The repaired charts passed every conservation and systems gate, but one global 16-level scalar alphabet per coordinate recovered only 0.9261 of carry energy at step 8 and 0.9751 at step 80. The failure is therefore in carry quantization locality, not in the weight charts.
causal_basis.mechanism: c_fc and c_proj output rows are heteroskedastic. A global alphabet spends levels on incompatible row scales. Sharing levels over only eight adjacent output channels preserves one-byte-per-pair codes while adapting the scalar alphabet to local residual scale.
excluded_moves: endpoint training before this gate passes

candidate.name: pair_vq_cproj_fast_residual_plus_group8_sigma_delta
candidate.single_change: Replace each matrix-global pair of 16-level feedback alphabets with one pair per eight output channels.
candidate.weight_pair_code: one uint8 Cartesian code per pair, unchanged
candidate.inference_change: none; feedback exists only during training

accounting.extra_codec_work: vectorized group-local Lloyd fit and decode at each optimizer step; exact-host performance-gated

frozen_gate.expected_duration: under five minutes on PRO6 and therefore foreground-polled; attach a persistent watchdog immediately if observed duration exceeds five minutes

decision_policy.pass: Authorize exactly one matched 124M/0.5TPP endpoint against the sealed QK-only dense-MLP parent. Do not scale up.
decision_policy.codec_fail: Reject scalar alphabet locality as insufficient; next theory must change the carry codec family rather than tune group size.
decision_policy.systems_fail: Optimize the vectorized codec without changing its mathematical representation, then repeat this gate.
decision_policy.endpoint_fail_after_gate_pass: Keep weight and carry charts fixed and localize the remaining objective mismatch from fixed-checkpoint loss and functional probes.
